# PPR January 28 Releases

_Category: Past Releases · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**pheath** (1/28/2022):

Morning Release:

Ticket 10861 - Order of General Collateral has been updated to be most recent to oldest.


Afternoon Release:

Ticket 10845 - Search results are now retrievable for registrations containing the Leap Year February 29 date.
